title: Navy SEAL finds a black octagonal structure near McMurdo
summary: Jason Jorjani tells of Navy SEAL finds a black octagonal structure near McMurdo, about unspecified at Antarctica, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: highly polished black stone octagonal structure sticking out like 18 ft above the ice.

plain: Jason Jorjani, a researcher and writer, passes on an account he credits to Linda Moulton Howe, a journalist who covers UFO stories. As he tells it, a Navy SEAL, a member of the US Navy's special forces, came across a highly polished black stone structure with eight sides, sticking about 18 feet out of the ice near McMurdo, the main US research station in Antarctica. If true, it would mean something built and unexplained is buried under the Antarctic ice.
